title: Ned Pegs the Rail
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, first long vowels ai, ee, igh, 38-sound stage.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling looking up at a long empty washing line strung across a garden.
A small pile of cloth bits and wooden pegs sitting on the grass under the washing line.
Ned the duckling using his bill to clip a small cloth square onto the washing line with a wooden peg.
Ned the duckling pegging up two more cloth bits along the washing line.
The washing line now holding six small cloth squares in a neat row.
A wide view of the washing line completely filled with cloth squares, fluttering gently.
Ned the duckling standing proudly below the full washing line, chest out.
Ned the duckling curled up asleep on the grass under the full washing line.
